text: Moving from the empty meeting room into this vibrant exhibit space fills me with a sense of transition—from the potential of dialogue and collaboration to the public expression of ideas in research and development. The colors and displays are stimulating, and I feel curiosity welling up, mingling with a quiet longing to connect the abstract knowledge here with the conversations happening behind glass. The museum-like ambiance prompts reflection on how knowledge is both created and displayed, urging me to ponder my own place amid these overlapping domains of thought and invention.
